about: Reproducible behavior with target-specific evidence
title: ''

assignees: ''
---

## Environment

Target (mock/live), revision, OS, Python/Playwright/browser, device and seed.

## Reproduction

Exact command, scenario/node ID, preconditions and smallest reproducible steps.
Use synthetic example.com data. Do not include credentials or session tokens.

## Expected and actual behavior

Link the observed contract. Separate application failure, automation error and
unresolved environment symptoms; a timeout alone does not establish the cause.

## Evidence and impact

Actual counts, report/run URL and reviewed screenshots. Describe affected scope,
whether the issue repeats and any known workaround. Keep raw live traces private.
